body.name: Declared regular chart stratum \(\mathcal P_{\kappa}\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{\kappa}=\{P_W\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm{HL}}_{K,T}(\mathcal U,\mathcal V):\sigma_{\min}(H_{\mathcal U,\mathcal V})\ge\kappa_H,\ \sigma_{\min}(\bar K_0)\ge\kappa_0,\ \sigma_{\min}(V_F)\ge\kappa_F,\ \operatorname{span}(V_F)=\operatorname{span}(V_D),\ \min_{(g,r)\in\mathcal G}p_g\ge\kappa_p,\ \min_j\Sigma_{jj}\ge\kappa_V\}\).
